newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm, trend unclear ahead US data.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm, trend unclear ahead US data.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds mainly firmed on local interest but trading was thin after the New Year and Christmas holidays, with the market awaiting U.S. data due on Thursday and Friday, dealers said on Wednesday.
MinFins like other emerging market paper track U.S.
Treasuries, and so are affected by U.S. statistics.
Tuesday, January 7, was a holiday in Russia.
"Almost all prices edged up in the morning. People have come back after holidays and saw low levels which prices had been at since late December," Avtobank dealer Pavel Afanasyev said.
But he added trading was thin on market uncertainty of the early trend in 1997.

"We have the market which is very much on the waiting side due to the uncertainty about U.S. Treasuries' trend and (US) figures due to be announced on Thursday and Friday," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
"The market is small, there is no definite trend but there is good support at current levels," he added.
